about_short_description.short_description: Petcube is a worldwide leader in pet cameras & software, connecting pets to the internet and giving them a voice.

product.name: Petcube Cam 360
product.description: A pet monitoring camera with 360° pan-tilt rotation, 1080p HD video, two-way audio, and smart alerts for remote pet monitoring and interaction.

product.name: Petcube Cam
product.description: A pet camera offering 1080p HD video, two-way audio, and wide-angle view for remote pet monitoring and communication.

product.name: Petcube Bites 2 Lite
product.description: A pet camera with 1080p HD video, two-way audio, ultra-wide 160° view, and remote treat dispensing with adjustable treat sizes.

product.name: Petcube Care
product.description: A subscription service providing smart alerts, video history, 30-second video clips, and 24/7 access to online veterinarians for pet monitoring and care.

product.name: Petcube GPS Tracker
product.description: A GPS tracking device for dogs that provides real-time location, activity monitoring, and escape alerts.

product.name: Petcube Fountain
product.description: A pet water fountain with a 4-layer filtration system and UV-C purification to provide fresh, clean water for pets.
